== Description ==
'''Bumper Cart''' is an emote obtained from the [[Hexscape Event#Hexscape Event Battle Pass|Hexscape Event Battle Pass]]. It was made by STEALTH_NOVA, Vylith and SoupedGun. The emote is looped and players can move while performing this emote. No music can be heard while performing this emote. Players can honk while using this emote.

'''Bumper Cart''' puts the player in a bumper cart, which can bump into the environment and other bumper carts. Additionally, critical hit visual effects also appear.

This emote could be obtained at Level 37 of the premium track, where it costed {{CandyCorns|1,320 Candy Corns}} or {{Robux|104}} ({{Robux|78}} for the Black Friday 2024 Sale) to unlock. It had a total cost of {{CandyCorns|22,860 Candy Corns}} or {{Robux|3,216}} ({{Robux|2,413}} for the Black Friday 2024 Sale).

==Trivia==
*'''Bumper Cart''' is likely a reference to the [https://wiki.teamfortress.com/wiki/Bumper_Cars Bumper Cars] that appear in the [https://wiki.teamfortress.com/wiki/Carnival_of_Carnage Carnival of Carnage] from ''Team Fortress 2''.
*There actually used to be another [[Bumper Kart]] emote prior to the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], which was an exclusive emote. However, the bumper cart had much less detail and was red.
*The emote is incorrectly referred to as a [https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/cart#Noun cart] instead of a [https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/kart#Noun kart].
